article.title: 'Happy Moscow burning day': Ukraine official account's X post draws criticism
article.summary: ALBAWABA - The official account of Ukraine drew mixed reactions after a post on X celebrating fires in Moscow following a drone attack by Kyiv.On Sunday, Sept. 20, the official X account of Ukraine shared an image showing black smoke rising from multiple sites across Moscow following a drone attack by the Ukrainian military.The caption of the photo caused a wave of anger on social media after Ukraine hailed the attack and wrote, "Good morning and happy Moscow burning day", followed by a fire emoji.The post gained massive engagement with more than 9 million views in addition to thousands of comments and reposts.Many of the comments were angry that Ukraine is celebrating attacks that could cause harm to innocent people and Russian civilians. One person said, "Killing innocent people who are not involved with the war is not a flex."
